description.value: Starzzz Convenience is a small-format Indian grocery and convenience store (1,324 sq ft) carrying South Asian groceries, dairy, frozen foods, drinks, and personal care products. The brand also offers ATM cash withdrawal and courier/package services. It sits in a strip-mall unit on King Road in Abbotsford, making it a potential stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, paid) at 9m; staple (4 spaces, covered) at 96m. Total: 6 spaces.
